reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 40 original B1/B2 adjective questions: checked every complete German sentence, inflected forms, all four options per variant, accepted keys, bilingual explanations, and distinct contexts. Contrasted unentschieden sports/person senses, untergeordnet hierarchy/importance, ungefähr adjective/adverb, ursprünglich past/current, and related untergliedert/unterteilt with different contexts. No inherited example copied. Independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review pending.
